    Bug 1823084 - Update strings from Junk to Spam. r=mkmelin
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    "Junk" is sometimes used as a derogatory term, and more recently
    Spam is more commonly used in email software and services.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D237151

         <spacer flex="1"/>

-                data-l10n-id="reset-junk-button"
